english: Yes... I believe that you are correct. It feels different, in this form.
french: Oui... je crois que tu as raison. Les sensations sont différentes, sous cette forme.
russian:
Да... Я полагаю, ты

правы

праваправправо. В этой форме это ощущается по-другому.
bulgarian: Yes... I believe that you are correct. It feels different, in this form.

english: I suppose that is why my heart beats faster when you are near.
french: J'imagine que c'est pour cela que mon cœur bat plus vite quand tu es près de moi.
russian: Видимо, поэтому моё сердце бьётся быстрее, когда ты рядом.
bulgarian: I suppose that is why my heart beats faster when you are near.

english: And a heat in my chest seems to rise, like a breath of flame.
french: Et qu'une chaleur dans ma poitrine semble grandir, tel un souffle de feu.
russian: И в груди поднимается жар, будто огненное дыхание.
bulgarian: And a heat in my chest seems to rise, like a breath of flame.

english: To know that you feel the same way... it must be destiny.
french: Savoir que tu ressens la même chose... ce doit être le destin.
russian: Теперь я знаю, что ты чувствуешь то же самое... Должно быть, это судьба.
bulgarian: To know that you feel the same way... it must be destiny.

english: Not only that you would become my Dragonsworn-
french: Non seulement que tu deviennes mon paladin du dragon...
russian:
Ты

стали

сталасталстало не только моим драконоверным...
bulgarian: Not only that you would become my Dragonsworn-

english: Please, have as much as you like.
french: Je t'en prie, ressers-toi autant que tu veux.
russian: Пожалуйста, бери, сколько захочешь.
bulgarian: Please, have as much as you like.

english: But also my mate.
french: Mais aussi <he>mon partenaire</he><she>ma partenaire</she><they>un·e partenaire</they>.
russian: Но и моим партнёром.
bulgarian: But also my mate.

english: What a delightful sensation... the softness of your lips on mine.
french: Quelle sensation délicieuse... la douceur de tes lèvres sur les miennes.
russian: Какое приятное ощущение... Твои мягкие губы касаются моих.
bulgarian: What a delightful sensation... the softness of your lips on mine.

english: I should like to repeat it. Many times.
french: J'aimerais que cela se répète. De nombreuses fois.
russian: Я бы хотел его повторить. Многократно.
bulgarian: I should like to repeat it. Many times.

english: For now, shall we head back inside? It is about time I prepared some tea... and dessert, of course.
french: Pour l'instant, si nous retournions à l'intérieur ? Il est temps que je prépare du thé... et un dessert, bien sûr.
russian: А пока пойдём обратно в дом? Мне пора приготовить чай... и десерт, разумеется.
bulgarian: For now, shall we head back inside? It is about time I prepared some tea... and dessert, of course.

english: Creative? Do you really think so?
french: Créatif ? Tu le penses vraiment ?
russian: Интересная? Ты правда так думаешь?
bulgarian: Creative? Do you really think so?

english: Welcome, [Ari]!
french: Bienvenue, [Ari] !
russian: Добро пожаловать, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Welcome, [Ari]!

english: Moreso with your company.
french: Plus encore en ta compagnie.
bulgarian: Moreso with your company.

english: And what kismet it was, to form a pact with a soul who instinctively understood my life's purpose.
french: Et quel destin que le mien de former un pacte avec une âme qui comprenait d'instinct le but de mon existence.
bulgarian: And what kismet it was, to form a pact with a soul who instinctively understood my life's purpose.

english: I thought you would come to me only when you were in need, as it has always been between myself and mortals.
french: Je pensais que tu ne viendrais me voir que lorsque tu en avais besoin, comme il en a toujours été entre moi et les mortels.
bulgarian: I thought you would come to me only when you were in need, as it has always been between myself and mortals.

english: But sometimes you would come to me simply to... talk. And it was in those times that I felt my heart begin to change.
french: Mais parfois, tu t'adressais à moi simplement pour... parler. Et c'est dans ces moments-là que j'ai senti mon cœur commencer à changer.
bulgarian: But sometimes you would come to me simply to... talk. And it was in those times that I felt my heart begin to change.

english: Before you, I had always thought of my role as that of a caretaker... tending to the garden of Mistria while being held slightly apart.
french: Avant toi, j'avais toujours envisagé mon rôle comme celui d'un gardien... prenant soin du jardin de Mistria tout en étant tenu légèrement à l'écart.
bulgarian: Before you, I had always thought of my role as that of a caretaker... tending to the garden of Mistria while being held slightly apart.

english: Who I am has always brought with it a certain measure of deference, even worship...
french: Être qui je suis a toujours impliqué une part de déférence, d'adoration, même...
bulgarian: Who I am has always brought with it a certain measure of deference, even worship...

english: And I thought I was happy being only what others needed me to be.
french: Et je me croyais heureux d'être seulement tel que les autres avaient besoin que je sois.
bulgarian: And I thought I was happy being only what others needed me to be.

english: But it is not so. You have shown me that I wish to stand in the garden, too.
french: Mais ce n'est pas le cas. Tu m'as montré que je désirais, moi aussi, faire partie de ce jardin.
bulgarian: But it is not so. You have shown me that I wish to stand in the garden, too.

english: It was your guidance that helped me find my place as well.
french: Tu m'as servi de guide et aidé à trouver ma place, moi aussi.
bulgarian: It was your guidance that helped me find my place as well.

english: Our pact is important, but what really helped me were the times you listened.
french: Le pacte qui nous lie est important, mais l'aide véritable, ça a été ton écoute.
bulgarian: Our pact is important, but what really helped me were the times you listened.

english: Truly? Then it seems it is mutual.
french: Vraiment ? Alors cela semble réciproque.
bulgarian: Truly? Then it seems it is mutual.

english: It is undeniable, the ways I have begun to change under your influence.
french: Il est indéniable que sous ton influence, j'ai commencé à changer de plusieurs façons.
bulgarian: It is undeniable, the ways I have begun to change under your influence.

english: Mingling with the townsfolk, learning to cook...
french: En me mêlant aux habitants, en apprenant à cuisiner...
bulgarian: Mingling with the townsfolk, learning to cook...

english: This place... something about it always brings you to mind.
french: Ce lieu... Il y a en lui quelque chose qui me fait toujours penser à toi.
bulgarian: This place... something about it always brings you to mind.

english: These are things I would not have allowed myself, once.
french: Autant de choses que je ne me serais jamais autorisé, jadis.
bulgarian: These are things I would not have allowed myself, once.

english: But you have shown me the way...
french: Mais tu m'as montré la voie...
bulgarian: But you have shown me the way...

english: You have opened my eyes, and my heart.
french: Tu m'as ouvert les yeux, et le cœur.
bulgarian: You have opened my eyes, and my heart.

english: I wish for us to always be together, [Ari]. Regardless of lifetime, regardless of form.
french: Je souhaite que nous soyons toujours ensemble, [Ari]. Quelle que soit la durée de notre vie, quelle que soit notre forme.
bulgarian: I wish for us to always be together, [Ari]. Regardless of lifetime, regardless of form.

english: Ah, that reminds me... There is something I wish to show you.
french: Ah, cela me rappelle que... j'aimerais te montrer quelque chose.
bulgarian: Ah, that reminds me... There is something I wish to show you.

english: That is why I put chisel to stone for the first time in a millenia...
french: Voilà pourquoi mon ciseau a heurté la pierre pour la première fois depuis mille ans...
bulgarian: That is why I put chisel to stone for the first time in a millenia...

english: I... made something for you. I call it the $Dragonsworn Statue$.
french: J'ai... fabriqué quelque chose pour toi. J'ai appelé cela la $statue de paladin du dragon$.
bulgarian: I... made something for you. I call it the $Dragonsworn Statue$.

english: To sculpt the $Dragonsworn Statue$.
french: Pour sculpter la $statue de paladin du dragon$.
bulgarian: To sculpt the $Dragonsworn Statue$.

english: It has been a millenia since I put chisel to stone... I hope I did justice to your countenance.
french: Cela fait mille ans que mon ciseau n'avait pas heurté la pierre... J'espère avoir rendu justice à ta stature.
bulgarian: It has been a millenia since I put chisel to stone... I hope I did justice to your countenance.

english: I thought of you as I worked.
french: J'ai pensé à toi en travaillant !
bulgarian: I thought of you as I worked.

english: I thought of you as I worked. As I... frequently do.
french: J'ai pensé à toi en travaillant ! Comme... souvent.
bulgarian: I thought of you as I worked. As I... frequently do.

english: As I... frequently do.
french: Comme... souvent.
bulgarian: As I... frequently do.

english: And I thought that perhaps you could place the statue on your farm, near my own.
french: Et je me suis dit que tu pourrais peut-être placer la statue sur ta ferme, près de la mienne.
bulgarian: And I thought that perhaps you could place the statue on your farm, near my own.

english: So that no matter how much time passes... a part of us will remain there together, always.
french: Afin que, quel que soit le temps qui passe... une partie de nous reste là, ensemble.
bulgarian: So that no matter how much time passes... a part of us will remain there together, always.

english: It is an old, melancholy feeling...
french: C'est un sentiment ancien, mélancolique...
bulgarian: It is an old, melancholy feeling...

english: Forgive me for speaking at length.
french: Pardonne-moi d'avoir parlé aussi longuement.
bulgarian: Forgive me for speaking at length.

english: There was something you wished to discuss today, was there not?
french: Tu souhaitais m'entretenir de quelque chose, aujourd'hui, n'est-ce pas ?
bulgarian: There was something you wished to discuss today, was there not?

english: I wanted to talk to you about our future together...
french: Je voulais te parler de notre avenir ensemble...
bulgarian: I wanted to talk to you about our future together...

english: Let's talk about it another time...
french: Parlons-en une autre fois...
bulgarian: Let's talk about it another time...

english: Our future together.
french: Notre avenir ensemble.
bulgarian: Our future together.

english: I love you, Caldarus. Will you marry me?
french: Je t'aime, Caldarus. Veux-tu m'épouser ?
bulgarian: I love you, Caldarus. Will you marry me?

english: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.
french: Mais parlons-en plus longuement une autre fois, plutôt.
bulgarian: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.

english: Another time? As you wish.
french: Une autre fois ? Comme tu veux.
bulgarian: Another time? As you wish.

english: Just know, I am always near if you have need of me.
french: Sache seulement que je serai toujours près de toi, si tu as besoin de moi.
bulgarian: Just know, I am always near if you have need of me.

english: [Ari]... you...
bulgarian: [Ari]... you...

english: Yes. It would be my honor...
french: Oui. Ce serait pour moi un honneur...
bulgarian: Yes. It would be my honor...

english: And my most heartfelt wish come true!
french: Et la réalisation de mon souhait le plus cher !
bulgarian: And my most heartfelt wish come true!

english: And a new, joyous one.
french: Et un autre récent, plein de joie.
bulgarian: And a new, joyous one.

english: You have made me so happy this day, [Ari]...
french: Tu m'as rendu si heureux aujourd'hui, [Ari].
bulgarian: You have made me so happy this day, [Ari]...

english: I love you. With all my heart!
french: Je t'aime. De tout mon cœur !
bulgarian: I love you. With all my heart!

english: Oh my... This calls for a ceremony, does it not?
french: Diantre... Cela appelle une cérémonie, non ?
bulgarian: Oh my... This calls for a ceremony, does it not?

english: Let us make it a celebration to remember.
french: Célébrons l'événement afin que ce soit un jour inoubliable.
bulgarian: Let us make it a celebration to remember.

english: Another day? As you wish.
french: Un autre jour ? Comme tu veux.
bulgarian: Another day? As you wish.

english: Just know, I am always near if you have need of me.
french: Sache seulement que je serai toujours près de toi, si tu as besoin de moi.
bulgarian: Just know, I am always near if you have need of me.

english: These emotions... they should be at odds, should they not? But instead, they fit together like a puzzle.
french: De telles émotions... devraient être contradictoires, n'est-ce pas ? Mais au contraire, elles s'assemblent telles les pièces d'un puzzle.
bulgarian: These emotions... they should be at odds, should they not? But instead, they fit together like a puzzle.

english: Forgive me. I always come to you when I cannot understand my own feelings.
french: Pardonne-moi. Je te sollicite toujours quand je n'arrive pas à comprendre mes propres sentiments.
bulgarian: Forgive me. I always come to you when I cannot understand my own feelings.

english: You're cute when you're like this.
french: Tu es mignon, quand tu es comme ça.
bulgarian: You're cute when you're like this.

english: You've always been a guide. It's my turn.
french: Tu as toujours été pour moi un guide. À mon tour de l'être.
bulgarian: You've always been a guide. It's my turn.

english: Is that so? Perhaps I need not be so shy about sharing, then.
french: Vraiment ? Peut-être devrais-je être moins timide quand il s'agit de les partager.
bulgarian: Is that so? Perhaps I need not be so shy about sharing, then.

english: When you repaired my statue and woke me, my first thought was of Mistria.
french: Quand tu as réparé ma statue et m'as réveillé, ma première pensée a été pour Mistria.
bulgarian: When you repaired my statue and woke me, my first thought was of Mistria.

english: These woods are beautiful this time of year.
french: Ces bois sont magnifiques à cette période de l'année.
bulgarian: These woods are beautiful this time of year.

english: There is something you wish to speak of? Of course.
french: Tu souhaites me parler de quelque chose ? Bien sûr.
bulgarian: There is something you wish to speak of? Of course.

english: Shall we go for a $walk in the woods$? I always enjoy my time spent with you.
french: Si nous allions faire une $promenade dans les bois$ ? J'apprécie toujours le temps passé avec toi.
bulgarian: Shall we go for a $walk in the woods$? I always enjoy my time spent with you.

english: Is something troubling you, [Ari]?
french: Quelque chose te tracasse-t-il, [Ari] ?
bulgarian: Is something troubling you, [Ari]?

english: I'm glad you could make it!
french: Je suis contente que tu aies pu venir !
russian:
Рада, что ты

смогли

смогласмогсмогло прийти!
bulgarian: I'm glad you could make it!

english: I thought it might like to join us for some fresh air and...
french: Je me suis dit qu'elle serait contente d'aller prendre un peu l'air et...
russian: Я подумала, вдруг ему понравится побыть с нами на свежем воздухе и...
bulgarian: I thought it might like to join us for some fresh air and...

english: Well, it has something to do with my theory, too.
french: Eh bien, ça a aussi un rapport avec mon hypothèse.
russian: Ещё я хочу проверить свою теорию.
bulgarian: Well, it has something to do with my theory, too.

english: Thanks, [Ari]. I'll carry the picnic basket.
french: Merci, [Ari]. Je me charge de porter le panier de pique-nique.
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]. А я понесу корзинку.
bulgarian: Thanks, [Ari]. I'll carry the picnic basket.

english: Isn't this nice? You can see all around us for miles...
french: C'est beau, n'est-ce pas ? On peut voir à des kilomètres à la ronde...
russian: Красиво, правда? Можно осмотреть всё так далеко вокруг.
bulgarian: Isn't this nice? You can see all around us for miles...

english: Isn't the view wonderful? I knew it would make the perfect setting for our date.
french: Est-ce que la vue n'est pas magnifique ? J'étais sûre que ce serait le cadre idéal pour notre rendez-vous.
russian: Чудесный вид, правда? Так и знала, что это идеальное место для свидания.
bulgarian: Isn't the view wonderful? I knew it would make the perfect setting for our date.

english: Here, I'll pour us some tea!
french: Tiens, je vais nous servir un peu de thé !
russian: Давай я налью нам чаю!
bulgarian: Here, I'll pour us some tea!

english: I've been meaning to ask you...
french: Je voulais te demander...
russian: Я хотела тебя спросить...
bulgarian: I've been meaning to ask you...

english: How are things going on the farm lately, [Ari]?
french: Comment ça se passe à la ferme en ce moment, [Ari] ?
russian: Как идут дела на ферме, [Ari]?
bulgarian: How are things going on the farm lately, [Ari]?

english: They're going well!
french: Tout va bien !
russian: Дела идут отлично!
bulgarian: They're going well!

english: Still a work in progress...
french: Tout n'est pas encore terminé...
russian: Ещё много работы...
bulgarian: Still a work in progress...

english: Um... How are things going on the farm lately, [Ari]?
french: Hum... Comment ça se passe à la ferme en ce moment, [Ari] ?
russian: Эм... Как идут дела на ферме, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Um... How are things going on the farm lately, [Ari]?

english: They're going well!
french: Tout va bien !
russian: Дела идут отлично!
bulgarian: They're going well!

english: Still a work in progress...
french: Tout n'est pas encore terminé...
russian: Ещё много работы...
bulgarian: Still a work in progress...

english: I'm so glad!
french: J'en suis ravie !
russian: Я рада!
bulgarian: I'm so glad!

english: I know that feeling! My garden is a continuous work in progress, too.
french: Je vois ce que tu veux dire ! Dans mon jardin aussi, les choses sont en perpétuelle évolution.
russian: Понимаю это чувство! В моём саду тоже всегда хватает работы.
bulgarian: I know that feeling! My garden is a continuous work in progress, too.

english: I can tell you put a lot of care into raising your crops.
french: Je vois tout le soin que tu mets dans tes cultures.
russian: Видно, что ты много стараешься над своим урожаем.
bulgarian: I can tell you put a lot of care into raising your crops.

english: I'm just finishing up the picnic preparations.
french: Je suis en train de terminer les préparatifs du pique-nique.
russian: Я как раз закончила приготовления к пикнику.
bulgarian: I'm just finishing up the picnic preparations.

english: It sounds silly but... it's almost magical to watch them grow, isn't it?
french: Ça va te paraître bête, mais... C'est presque magique de les voir pousser, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Это прозвучит глупо, но... Когда видишь, как растения растут, кажется, что это настоящая магия!
bulgarian: It sounds silly but... it's almost magical to watch them grow, isn't it?

english: You know, I never met anyone who really gets me when I talk about gardening...
french: Tu sais, je n'avais jamais rencontré personne qui me comprenne vraiment quand je parle de jardinage...
russian: Знаешь, я никогда не встречала человека, который правда меня понимает, когда я говорю о цветах...
bulgarian: You know, I never met anyone who really gets me when I talk about gardening...

english: Until I met you.
french: Avant de te rencontrer.
russian: Пока не познакомилась с тобой.
bulgarian: Until I met you.

english: U-Until I met you.
french: A-Avant de te rencontrer, toi.
russian: П-пока не познакомилась с тобой.
bulgarian: U-Until I met you.

english: It's not that I'm the only one in town with a green thumb. There's Hayden, and even Errol...
french: Je ne dis pas que je suis la seule en ville à avoir la main verte. Il y a Hayden, et même Errol...
russian: Я не одна в городе занимаюсь садоводством. Есть ещё Хейден и даже Эррол...
bulgarian: It's not that I'm the only one in town with a green thumb. There's Hayden, and even Errol...

english: But I can't picture either of them chasing after a lost flower from the Codex Mistria, can you?
french: Mais je n'imagine aucun d'eux partir à la recherche d'une fleur disparue à partir du Codex Mistria, tu vois ?
russian: Но я не могу представить, чтобы они бегали в поисках неизвестного цветка из «Кодекса Мистрии», понимаешь?
bulgarian: But I can't picture either of them chasing after a lost flower from the Codex Mistria, can you?

english: Growing up, I always loved to read stories about enchanted blossoms, giant beanstalks-
french: Quand j'étais enfant, j'ai toujours aimé lire des histoires parlant de floraisons enchantées, de haricots géants...
russian: Когда я была маленькая, мне всегда нравились сказки про колдовские цветы, огромные бобовые стебли...
bulgarian: Growing up, I always loved to read stories about enchanted blossoms, giant beanstalks-

english: Fantastical tales full of magic and dragons.
french: Des contes fantastiques remplis de magie et de dragons.
russian: Фантастические истории с магией и драконами.
bulgarian: Fantastical tales full of magic and dragons.

english: At night I'd dream of mysterious forests and hidden sanctuaries filled with beautiful flowers. White, purple, and brilliant gold.
french: La nuit, je rêvais de forêts mystérieuses, de sanctuaires cachés pleins de fleurs magnifiques : blanches, violettes et d'un doré lumineux.
russian: По ночам мне снились волшебные леса и затерянные святилища с прекрасными цветами. Белыми, фиолетовыми и сияющими золотом.
bulgarian: At night I'd dream of mysterious forests and hidden sanctuaries filled with beautiful flowers. White, purple, and brilliant gold.

english: I'd dream that I had grown them all myself.
french: Je rêvais que c'est moi qui les avais fait pousser.
russian: В этих снах я вырастила их сама.
bulgarian: I'd dream that I had grown them all myself.

english: So you can imagine my excitement when Errol let me borrow an ancient book of flora he found in the town's archives.
french: Je te laisse donc imaginer mon excitation quand Errol m'a permis d'emprunter un ancien livre sur la flore qu'il avait découvert dans les archives de la ville.
russian: Так что можешь представить, как я обрадовалась, когда Эррол одолжил мне книгу о древней флоре, раскопанную в городских архивах.
bulgarian: So you can imagine my excitement when Errol let me borrow an ancient book of flora he found in the town's archives.

english: I made cucumber sandwiches, cake, and tea.
french: J'ai fait des sandwichs au concombre, un gâteau et du thé.
russian: У меня есть сэндвичи с огурцом, тортик и чай.
bulgarian: I made cucumber sandwiches, cake, and tea.

english: That sounds delicious!
french: Ça a l'air délicieux !
russian: Звучит очень вкусно!
bulgarian: That sounds delicious!

english: What kind of cake?
french: C'est un gâteau à quoi ?
russian: А что за тортик?
bulgarian: What kind of cake?

english: My nose was always in one book or another, but poring through the Codex for the first time, something happened...
french: J'avais toujours le nez dans les bouquins, mais quand j'ai parcouru le Codex pour la première fois, il s'est passé quelque chose...
russian: Я книжный червь, вечно беру то одну книгу, то другую. Но когда я впервые зачиталась «Кодексом Мистрии», случилось нечто особенное...

russian: Спорим, тут повсюду зарыты сокровища!
bulgarian: Bet there's a lot of treasure around!

english: I'd say you're more of a collaborator! You've got a talent for archaeology, [Ari].
french: Tu fais bien plus que de m'assister ! Tu as un véritable don pour l'archéologie, [Ari].
russian: Я бы сказал, ты, скорее, коллега! У тебя талант к археологии, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'd say you're more of a collaborator! You've got a talent for archaeology, [Ari].

english: Anything we find here could have immense archaeological value! Let's keep our eyes open.
french: Tout ce que nous trouverons ici pourrait avoir une valeur archéologique inestimable ! Nous devons ouvrir l'œil, et le bon.
russian: Всё, что мы здесь найдём, может представлять громадную ценность для археологии! Надо быть внимательными.
bulgarian: Anything we find here could have immense archaeological value! Let's keep our eyes open.

english: The writing you uncovered at the stele was illuminating.
french: Les écrits que tu as découverts sur la stèle ont été une révélation.
russian:
Надпись на стеле, которую ты

открыли

открылаоткрылоткрыло, многое нам раскрыла.
bulgarian: The writing you uncovered at the stele was illuminating.

english: It implies that the people who hid the $Dragonsworn Armor$ believed that its ability to defend wasn't just in wearing the armor itself.
french: Cela signifie que les personnes qui ont caché l'armure du paladin du dragon estimaient que ses capacités défensives ne résidaient pas uniquement dans le simple fait de la porter.
russian: Из неё следует, что люди, спрятавшие доспехи драконоверного, верили, что они защищают не только владельца.
bulgarian: It implies that the people who hid the $Dragonsworn Armor$ believed that its ability to defend wasn't just in wearing the armor itself.

english: They thought that a single piece of the armor could protect an entire area.
french: Ils semblaient penser qu'un seul élément de l'armure pouvait protéger une région entière.
russian: Они считали, что даже часть доспехов способна защитить землю вокруг.
bulgarian: They thought that a single piece of the armor could protect an entire area.

english: Which makes me believe that the $Western Ruins$ are a good candidate for uncovering more pieces!
french: C'est pourquoi je pense que nous avons de grandes chances de découvrir d'autres morceaux de l'armure dans les ruines de l'ouest !
russian: Это приводит меня к выводу, что другие части следует искать в Западных руинах!
bulgarian: Which makes me believe that the $Western Ruins$ are a good candidate for uncovering more pieces!

english: So are you ready to roll up your sleeves and begin the hunt? It's a big site to cover!
french: Alors, que dirais-tu de te retrousser les manches et de commencer à chercher ? Ce site est immense, il y a de quoi faire !
russian:
Ну что,

готовы

готоваготовготово закатать рукава и начать поиски? Это большой участок!
bulgarian: So are you ready to roll up your sleeves and begin the hunt? It's a big site to cover!

english: [Ari]! Welcome, welcome. Take it all in, isn't it magnificent?
french: [Ari] ! Je te souhaite la bienvenue ! Prends le temps d'admirer tout cela, c'est superbe non ?
russian: [Ari]! Добро пожаловать. Оглядись вокруг, разве не чудесно?
bulgarian: [Ari]! Welcome, welcome. Take it all in, isn't it magnificent?

english: The $Dragonsworn Helmet$! At our Museum! I'm beside myself. Thank you so much, [Ari]!
french: Notre musée abrite le casque du paladin du dragon ! Je suis aux anges. Merci infiniment, [Ari].
russian: Шлем драконоверного! В нашем музее! Я вне себя от счастья. Спасибо тебе огромное, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The $Dragonsworn Helmet$! At our Museum! I'm beside myself. Thank you so much, [Ari]!

english: Haha... about that...
french: Ha ha... En réalité...
russian: Ха-ха... Ну почти...
bulgarian: Haha... about that...

english: It's hardly an adventure, but can I count on you to help me search?
french: Ce n'est pas vraiment une aventure, mais je peux compter sur toi pour les recherches ?
russian: Это сложно назвать приключением, и всё же ты можешь помочь мне в поисках?
bulgarian: It's hardly an adventure, but can I count on you to help me search?

english: I'm in! What are friends for?
french: Bien sûr ! À quoi servent les amis ?
russian: Я в деле! Для чего ещё нужны друзья?
bulgarian: I'm in! What are friends for?

english: Maybe we'll leave today's adventure out of the history books...
french: Cette aventure n'entrera sûrement pas dans les livres d'histoire...
russian: Возможно, в учебниках истории про сегодняшнее приключение лучше не писать...
bulgarian: Maybe we'll leave today's adventure out of the history books...

english: Thank you, [Ari]!
french: Merci, [Ari] !
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]!

english: Haha... I was thinking the same thing.
french: Ha ha... Je me disais exactement la même chose.
russian: Ха-ха... Я тоже об этом подумал.
bulgarian: Haha... I was thinking the same thing.

english: Now as you might imagine, I've already done a thorough job of combing through my own rooms. So we'll start with my sister's office.
french: Bien, comme tu peux te l'imaginer, j'ai déjà passé au peigne fin toutes les pièces me concernant. Nous commencerons donc par le bureau de ma sœur.
russian: Как ты, наверное, догадываешься, я уже тщательно порылся в своих комнатах. Так что начнём с кабинета моей сестры.
bulgarian: Now as you might imagine, I've already done a thorough job of combing through my own rooms. So we'll start with my sister's office.

english: Hey, you two!
french: Bonjour, vous deux !
russian: Эй, вы двое!
bulgarian: Hey, you two!

english: Let me guess, you heard I was consolidating old council minutes and want in on the action?
french: Vous avez entendu que je compilais de vieux rapports du conseil et vous voulez vous amuser, vous aussi ?
russian: Дайте угадаю: вы узнали, что я собираю старые протоколы заседаний совета, и загорелись энтузиазмом?
bulgarian: Let me guess, you heard I was consolidating old council minutes and want in on the action?

english: Don't feel bad saying no. I'm just keeping Adeline company.
french: Vous avez le droit de refuser. Je tiens compagnie à Adeline, rien d'autre.
russian: Не бойтесь сказать «нет». Я уже составляю компанию Аделине.
bulgarian: Don't feel bad saying no. I'm just keeping Adeline company.

english: [Ari] and I are on an important mission, hunting for the cloak of the $Dragonsworn$.
french: [Ari] et moi avons une mission importante. Nous cherchons le manteau du paladin du dragon.
russian: [Ari] и я занимаемся важным делом: мы разыскиваем плащ драконоверного.
bulgarian: [Ari] and I are on an important mission, hunting for the cloak of the $Dragonsworn$.

english: I believe it may be somewhere in this very building!
french: Je pense qu'il se trouve dans cette maison !
russian: Я полагаю, что он находится где-то в этом здании.
bulgarian: I believe it may be somewhere in this very building!

english: Oh my, how exciting!
french: Ça alors, c'est incroyable !
russian: Как увлекательно!
bulgarian: Oh my, how exciting!

english: Haha, well... in a sense?
french: Ha ha, eh bien... en quelque sorte.
russian: Ха-ха, ну... в некотором смысле «да»?
bulgarian: Haha, well... in a sense?

english: Well feel free to search my office, but I don't think that I've seen anything like that here.
french: Bien, vous pouvez jeter un œil dans mon bureau, mais je n'ai jamais rien vu de tel.
russian: Что ж, можете обыскать мой кабинет, но, по-моему, я не видела тут ничего похожего.
bulgarian: Well feel free to search my office, but I don't think that I've seen anything like that here.

english: I suppose I should conduct a search of my own room then.
french: Je devrais sans doute fouiller dans ma propre chambre.
russian: Вероятно, тогда и мне стоит обследовать свою комнату.
bulgarian: I suppose I should conduct a search of my own room then.

english: Oh, I'd be happy to help-
french: Oh, je veux bien t'aider...
russian: О, я буду рад помочь...
bulgarian: Oh, I'd be happy to help-

english: Let's leave your auntie some privacy, eh?
french: Que dirais-tu de laisser ta vieille tante gérer ça toute seule, hein ?
russian: Дай тётушке немного личного пространства, ладно?
bulgarian: Let's leave your auntie some privacy, eh?

english: This takes me back. It's a bit like the signet ring all over again, isn't it?
french: Ça me rappelle des souvenirs. C'est un peu comme l'histoire de la chevalière, non ?
russian: Прямо как в детстве. Снова будет, как с кольцом-печаткой, да?
bulgarian: This takes me back. It's a bit like the signet ring all over again, isn't it?

english: When we were kids, Eiland found an old ring down in the basement.
french: Quand nous étions petits, Eiland a trouvé une vieille bague dans les caves.
russian: Когда мы были маленькие, Эйланд нашёл в подвале старинное кольцо.
bulgarian: When we were kids, Eiland found an old ring down in the basement.

english: He liked it so much he and Mother did a bunch of research to find out whose crest was on it.
french: Il l'aimait tellement que mère et lui ont fait des tas de recherches pour savoir quel était le sceau dont elle était ornée.
russian: Ему оно очень понравилось, и они с мамой вдвоём долго исследовали, чей на нём герб.
bulgarian: He liked it so much he and Mother did a bunch of research to find out whose crest was on it.

english: It turned out to be the signet ring of a very, very old Caldosian dynasty, long thought lost.
french: Il s'avéra que c'était la chevalière d'une dynastie caldosienne très très ancienne que l'on croyait disparue depuis longtemps.
russian: Оказалось, что это кольцо-печатка очень-очень древней кальдосийской династии, давно считавшееся утерянным.
bulgarian: It turned out to be the signet ring of a very, very old Caldosian dynasty, long thought lost.

english: Well Mother was so proud, she had it sent off to the Capital to be verified, and then the Caldosians got word of it...
french: Mère en était tellement fière qu'elle la fit envoyer à la capitale pour la faire expertiser, et quand les Caldosiens eurent vent de son existence...
russian: Ну и мама очень обрадовалась и отправила его в столицу на проверку, а затем об этом узнали кальдосийцы...
bulgarian: Well Mother was so proud, she had it sent off to the Capital to be verified, and then the Caldosians got word of it...

english: The Caldosians must have been thrilled!
french: Ils ont dû être ravis !
russian: Кальдосийцы наверняка обрадовались ещё больше!
bulgarian: The Caldosians must have been thrilled!

english: Let me guess, you didn't get your ring back?
french: Vous n'avez jamais revu la bague, c'est ça ?
russian: Дай угадаю: кольцо вам уже не вернули?
bulgarian: Let me guess, you didn't get your ring back?

english: It ended up being a bit of an international incident, actually.
french: Cela a bien failli provoquer un incident diplomatique, à vrai dire.
russian: Вообще-то, это был небольшой международный скандал.
bulgarian: It ended up being a bit of an international incident, actually.

english: After translating the text and putting the clues together, I have become convinced that the next piece of the armor is...
french: Après avoir traduit le texte et déchiffré les différents indices, je suis maintenant convaincu que le morceau d'armure suivante se trouve...
russian: Переведя текст и сопоставив имеющиеся данные, я убедился, что следующая часть доспехов...
bulgarian: After translating the text and putting the clues together, I have become convinced that the next piece of the armor is...

english: It would have ended up in a museum regardless, but no.
french: Elle aurait de toute façon fini par atterrir dans un musée, mais non.
russian: Оно в любом случае ушло в музей, но да, не вернули.
bulgarian: It would have ended up in a museum regardless, but no.

english: Well, it certainly gave you your taste for archaeology at any rate.
french: Quoi qu'il en soit, c'est ce qui t'a donné goût à l'archéologie.
russian: Так или иначе, этот случай разжёг твою страсть к археологии.
bulgarian: Well, it certainly gave you your taste for archaeology at any rate.

english: And the Caldosians got their ring back eventually. I even got an official thank you letter from their Emperor.
french: Et les Caldosiens ont récupéré leur chevalière, en fin de compte. J'ai même reçu une lettre de remerciement officielle de leur empereur.
russian: А кальдосийцы, наконец, обрели своё утраченное кольцо. Я даже получил официальное письмо с благодарностью от их императора.
bulgarian: And the Caldosians got their ring back eventually. I even got an official thank you letter from their Emperor.

english: Fooooound it!
french: Je l'ai trouvééé !
russian: Нашла-а-а!
bulgarian: Fooooound it!

english: Aunt Elsie, perhaps you should let a certified archaeologist check first-
french: Tante Elsie, laisse donc un archéologue certifié en vérifier d'abord l'authenti...
russian: Тётушка Элси, возможно, лучше вначале дать проверить квалифицированному археологу...
bulgarian: Aunt Elsie, perhaps you should let a certified archaeologist check first-

english: It really IS the $Dragonsworn Cloak$! It certainly doesn't look that ancient, does it?
french: C'est bien le manteau du paladin du dragon ! Mais il n'a pas l'air si vieux que ça, non ?
russian: Это ТОЧНО тот самый плащ драконоверного!
bulgarian: It really IS the $Dragonsworn Cloak$! It certainly doesn't look that ancient, does it?

english: Wherever did you find it?
french: Mais où l'as-tu trouvé ?
russian: Где же ты его откопала?
bulgarian: Wherever did you find it?

english: In my wardrobe. When I moved in I just shoved everything still in there as far back as it would go.
french: Dans ma garde-robe. Quand je me suis installée ici, j'ai seulement poussé tout ce qui était déjà là au fond de l'armoire.
russian: В моём гардеробе. Когда я сюда переехала, я затолкала поглубже всё, что там лежало.
bulgarian: In my wardrobe. When I moved in I just shoved everything still in there as far back as it would go.

english: Can you believe it, [Ari]? The third piece of the $Dragonsworn Armor$! Were there any notes with it? A storage box?
french: Je n'arrive pas à y croire, [Ari] ! C'est le troisième élément de l'armure du paladin du dragon ! Est-ce qu'il y avait des notes, avec ? Ou peut-être un coffret ?
russian: Представляешь, [Ari]? Третья часть доспехов драконоверного! При нём были какие-то заметки? Ящик, может быть?
bulgarian: Can you believe it, [Ari]? The third piece of the $Dragonsworn Armor$! Were there any notes with it? A storage box?

english: Oh no, it was folded up among a pile of old blankets.
french: Rien de tout ça, il était plié et rangé avec une pile de vieilles couvertures.
russian: О, нет, он был сложен в куче старых одеял.
bulgarian: Oh no, it was folded up among a pile of old blankets.

english: In this very house.
french: Ici même, dans cette maison.
russian: Прямо в этом доме.
bulgarian: In this very house.

english: I was afraid of this.
french: C'est ce que je craignais.
russian: Этого я и боялся.
bulgarian: I was afraid of this.

english: With no clues, it will make the next piece that much harder to find.
french: Si nous n'avons pas d'autres indices, l'élément d'armure suivant sera bien plus difficile à trouver.
russian: Следующую часть будет гораздо сложнее найти без зацепок.
bulgarian: With no clues, it will make the next piece that much harder to find.

english: Maybe it's recorded somewhere in the annals of the house? Those go back hundreds of years.
french: Et si tu cherchais dans les annales de la maison ? Elles remontent jusqu'à des centaines d'années.
russian: Может быть, где-то в летописи дома есть записи? Этой хронике много сотен лет.
bulgarian: Maybe it's recorded somewhere in the annals of the house? Those go back hundreds of years.

english: I think that might be our best bet.
french: Je crois que c'est notre seule option.
russian: Думаю, это наш лучший вариант.
bulgarian: I think that might be our best bet.

english: Let's hope our quest doesn't end here, [Ari].
french: Espérons que cela n'interrompe pas notre quête prématurément, [Ari].
russian: Будем надеяться, что наши поиски на этом не закончатся, [Ari].
bulgarian: Let's hope our quest doesn't end here, [Ari].

english: We won't stop till we complete the armor!
french: On n'arrêtera que lorsque l'armure sera complète !
russian: Мы не остановимся, пока не найдём весь доспех!
bulgarian: We won't stop till we complete the armor!

english: Three out of however many ain't bad!
french: Trois morceaux, ce n'est pas si mal !
russian: Три из скольки-то — уже неплохо!
bulgarian: Three out of however many ain't bad!

english: You're right! This is just another challenge to overcome.
french: Exactement ! C'est juste un obstacle de plus à surmonter.
russian:
Ты

правы

праваправправо! Это лишь очередное испытание на нашем пути.
bulgarian: You're right! This is just another challenge to overcome.

english: It's true, what we've recovered so far is amazing.
french: Certes, il est déjà extraordinaire que nous ayons trouvé tout cela.
russian: Это правда. Найденное уже впечатляет.
bulgarian: It's true, what we've recovered so far is amazing.

english: Whatever comes next, I say it's high time to celebrate what you two have achieved.
french: Qu'importe ce qui vient après, je crois qu'il est temps de célébrer ce que vous avez déjà accompli, vous deux.
russian: Что бы ни случилось дальше, я считаю, самое время отпраздновать ваши достижения.
bulgarian: Whatever comes next, I say it's high time to celebrate what you two have achieved.

english: And you!
french: Et toi, surtout !
russian: И твои тоже!
bulgarian: And you!

english: Just so! I'm going to get a bottle of that very old wine from down cellar.
french: Absolument ! Je vais chercher une bouteille de ce vieux vin, à la cave.
russian: Именно! Я схожу в подвал за той старинной бутылкой.
bulgarian: Just so! I'm going to get a bottle of that very old wine from down cellar.

english: I believe we are looking for the $Dragonsworn Cloak$, a truly excellent example of "Dynweaving" that imparted the cloth with incredible durability.
french: Je crois que nous sommes sur les traces du manteau du paladin du dragon. Il est fait dans un « tissu dragonique » qui lui donne une résistance incomparable.
russian: Я полагаю, что мы хотим найти плащ драконоверного. Это превосходный образец техники Дайноплетения, которая придаёт ткани невероятную долговечность.
bulgarian: I believe we are looking for the $Dragonsworn Cloak$, a truly excellent example of "Dynweaving" that imparted the cloth with incredible durability.

english: Cheers everyone!
french: Santé, tout le monde !
russian: За всех нас!
bulgarian: Cheers everyone!

english: Legends say it could turn aside swords, and even arrows couldn't pierce it.
french: Selon les légendes, il avait le pouvoir de repousser les lames et même les flèches ne pouvaient le transpercer.
russian: Согласно легендам, с него соскальзывали мечи, и даже стреле не под силу было его пронзить.
bulgarian: Legends say it could turn aside swords, and even arrows couldn't pierce it.

english: However, at some point the cloak became a symbol of the leader of Mistria. As fashion sensibilities changed, well...
french: Toutefois, le manteau a fini par être associé aux souverains de Mistria. Puis les modes ont changé, et...
russian: Однако через какое-то время плащ стал символом правителя Мистрии. А поскольку мода со временем меняется...
bulgarian: However, at some point the cloak became a symbol of the leader of Mistria. As fashion sensibilities changed, well...

english: Frankly, I think it ended up tucked away in some odd corner of the house.
french: À vrai dire, je pense qu'il a été rangé dans un coin de la maison avant d'être oublié.
russian: Честно говоря, я думаю, его в конце концов засунули в какой-нибудь дальний угол дома.
bulgarian: Frankly, I think it ended up tucked away in some odd corner of the house.

english: Luckily for us, nothing ever gets thrown away around here.
french: Heureusement pour nous, on ne jette rien dans la famille.
russian: Нам повезло, что здесь не принято ничего выбрасывать.
bulgarian: Luckily for us, nothing ever gets thrown away around here.

english: Thank you for coming, [Ari].
french: Merci d'être venu<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they>, [Ari].
russian:
Спасибо, что

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you for coming, [Ari].

english: Where are we off to? Ancient ruins? A forgotten temple?
french: Nous partons explorer d'anciennes ruines ? Ou un temple oublié ?
russian: Куда мы направляемся? В древние руины? В заброшенный храм?
bulgarian: Where are we off to? Ancient ruins? A forgotten temple?

english: Let me guess, you found a secret labyrinth in the Manor!
french: Laisse-moi deviner, tu as découvert un labyrinthe secret dans le manoir !
russian: Дай угадаю: ты нашёл в особняке скрытый лабиринт!
bulgarian: Let me guess, you found a secret labyrinth in the Manor!

english: Funny that our steps naturally took us here, isn't it?
french: C'est drôle que nos pas nous aient naturellement menés ici, non ?
bulgarian: Funny that our steps naturally took us here, isn't it?

english: I've always been struck by how the creators of these steles viewed them as a form of communication.
french: J'ai toujours été impressionné par les créateurs de ces stèles. Leur signification demeure limpide au fil des générations.
bulgarian: I've always been struck by how the creators of these steles viewed them as a form of communication.

english: A great big stone monument, with iconography meant to pass on important information...
french: Il s'agit d'un monolithe dont les dessins sont censés transmettre des informations importantes...
bulgarian: A great big stone monument, with iconography meant to pass on important information...

english: Yet the messages they were designed to pass on remained out of our reach for so long!
french: Pourtant, ces messages sont restés hors de portée pendant si longtemps !
bulgarian: Yet the messages they were designed to pass on remained out of our reach for so long!

english: In archaeology, there is so much that only becomes evident after you've assembled the whole picture.
french: En archéologie, il y a tant de choses qui ne deviennent évidentes qu'une fois le puzzle reconstitué.
bulgarian: In archaeology, there is so much that only becomes evident after you've assembled the whole picture.

english: Now that I think of it... Perhaps life is like that, too.
french: D'ailleurs... Il est peut-être possible d'en dire autant de nos existences.
bulgarian: Now that I think of it... Perhaps life is like that, too.

english: I was so lost in the hunt for the $Dragonsworn Armor$, that I didn't initially see the treasure right in front of me.
french: Cette quête de l'$armure du paladin du dragon$ m'obnubilait tellement que je n'ai pas tout de suite vu le joyau qui se tenait devant moi.
bulgarian: I was so lost in the hunt for the $Dragonsworn Armor$, that I didn't initially see the treasure right in front of me.

english: I'm referring to you, [Ari].
french: Je parle de toi, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'm referring to you, [Ari].

english: I treasure you as well, Eiland.
french: Toi aussi, tu es un trésor, Eiland.
bulgarian: I treasure you as well, Eiland.

english: Thinking about our first discovery together...

bulgarian: Thinking about our first discovery together...

english: Actually, that reminds me...
french: D'ailleurs, ça me rappelle...
bulgarian: Actually, that reminds me...

english: I suppose that's why...
french: Je suppose que c'est pour cela que...
bulgarian: I suppose that's why...

bulgarian: Well, I hope you won't think this too forward of me.

english: I had the $Legacy Stele$ commissioned for you.
french: J'ai commandé une $stèle honorifique$ pour toi.
bulgarian: I had the $Legacy Stele$ commissioned for you.

english: But I wanted to commemorate our adventures together in a way that was more permanent than a record in a book.
french: Mais je voulais rappeler les aventures que nous avons vécues ensemble bien mieux que laisser quelques lignes dans un livre.
bulgarian: But I wanted to commemorate our adventures together in a way that was more permanent than a record in a book.

english: I wanted to commemorate our adventures in a way that was more permanent than a record in a book.
french: Je voulais rappeler nos aventures bien mieux que laisser quelques lignes dans un livre.
bulgarian: I wanted to commemorate our adventures in a way that was more permanent than a record in a book.

english: So I had this $Legacy Stele$ commissioned.
french: J'ai donc commandé cette $stèle honorifique$ pour toi.
bulgarian: So I had this $Legacy Stele$ commissioned.

english: I hope you didn't think it was too forward of me.
french: J'espère que tu ne trouves pas cela trop cavalier de ma part.
bulgarian: I hope you didn't think it was too forward of me.

english: I know it's a bit over the top!
french: Je sais que c'est un peu exagéré !
bulgarian: I know it's a bit over the top!

english: I know it was a bit over the top!
french: Je sais que c'était un peu exagéré !
bulgarian: I know it was a bit over the top!

english: But when I think about us... well...
french: Mais quand je pense à nous... eh bien...
bulgarian: But when I think about us... well...

english: I don't feel shy in saying that I want our story to last forever.
french: Je suis assez fier de dire que j'aimerais voir notre histoire durer pour toujours.
bulgarian: I don't feel shy in saying that I want our story to last forever.

english: [Ari]... there's something I want to ask you.
french: [Ari]... Je veux te demander quelque chose.
bulgarian: [Ari]... there's something I want to ask you.

english: But before that, there was something you wanted to talk to me about, wasn't there?
french: Mais avant, tu souhaitais toi me parler de quelque chose, non ?
bulgarian: But before that, there was something you wanted to talk to me about, wasn't there?

english: Sorry for going on and on. I'll save my question for... for us to discuss another time.
french: Désolé, je parle, je parle. Je garde ma question pour... plus tard.
bulgarian: Sorry for going on and on. I'll save my question for... for us to discuss another time.

english: There's no need for us to wait.
french: Pourquoi attendre ?
bulgarian: There's no need for us to wait.

english: Let's talk about it another time...
french: Parlons-en une autre fois...
bulgarian: Let's talk about it another time...

english: More than anything, I was so happy to find someone taking an interest in Mistria's history.
french: Plus que ça, j'étais si heureux de rencontrer quelqu'un qui s'intéressait à l'histoire de Mistria.
bulgarian: More than anything, I was so happy to find someone taking an interest in Mistria's history.

english: Do you mean to say that you also...?
french: Est-ce que ça veut dire que toi aussi, tu...?
bulgarian: Do you mean to say that you also...?

english: I love you, Eiland. Will you marry me?
french: Je t'aime, Eiland. Veux-tu m'épouser ?
bulgarian: I love you, Eiland. Will you marry me?

english: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.
french: Mais parlons-en plus longuement une autre fois, plutôt.
bulgarian: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.

english: [Ari]!
french: [Ari] !
bulgarian: [Ari]!

english: Oh, [Ari]...
french: Oh, [Ari]...
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]...

english: It is the greatest honor of my life to say... yes!
french: Jamais je n'ai été aussi honoré de dire... oui !
bulgarian: It is the greatest honor of my life to say... yes!

english: I want nothing more than to spend the rest of my days by your side.
french: Il n'y a rien que je souhaite plus que de passer le restant de mes jours à tes côtés.
bulgarian: I want nothing more than to spend the rest of my days by your side.

english: This feeling...
french: Ce que je ressens...
bulgarian: This feeling...

english: It's indescribable. I've never felt so happy!
french: C'est quelque chose d'indescriptible. Jamais je ne me suis senti aussi heureux !
bulgarian: It's indescribable. I've never felt so happy!

english: I love you, [Ari].
french: Je t'aime, [Ari].
bulgarian: I love you, [Ari].

english: I can't believe we both hoped to propose today. What are the chances?
french: Je n'arrive pas à croire que nous ayons tous les deux eu l'idée de nous demander en mariage aujourd'hui. Quelle coïncidence, non ?
bulgarian: I can't believe we both hoped to propose today. What are the chances?

english: And then finding a piece of the $Dragonsworn Armor$! I was so thrilled I just... dashed off.
french: Et quand on a trouvé ce morceau de l'$armure du paladin du dragon$ ! J'étais tellement submergé par l'émotion que... je suis parti à toutes jambes.
bulgarian: And then finding a piece of the $Dragonsworn Armor$! I was so thrilled I just... dashed off.

english: There's no doubt about it... This is fate, [Ari]. We were always destined to share a shining future together.
french: Cela ne fait aucun doute... C'est le destin, [Ari]. Nous avons été destinés à partager ensemble un avenir radieux.
bulgarian: There's no doubt about it... This is fate, [Ari]. We were always destined to share a shining future together.

english: Oh! Of course, [Ari].
french: Oh ! Bien sûr, [Ari].
bulgarian: Oh! Of course, [Ari].

english: Just let me know when you want to talk again, this was a lovely walk.
french: Si tu veux que nous ayons une autre conversation, n'hésite pas. Celle-là m'a beaucoup plu.
bulgarian: Just let me know when you want to talk again, this was a lovely walk.

english: Looking back... I am sorry about that. I'm sure by now you know I sometimes get... over enthusiastic.
french: Maintenant que j'y repense... je suis désolé. Depuis le temps, tu sais que je me laisse facilement dépasser par... mon enthousiasme.
bulgarian: Looking back... I am sorry about that. I'm sure by now you know I sometimes get... over enthusiastic.

english: Your enthusiasm is one of my favorite things about you.
french: Ton enthousiasme est une des choses que j'adore chez toi.
bulgarian: Your enthusiasm is one of my favorite things about you.

english: I'd forgotten about that! Well, you're forgiven.
french: J'avais oublié ! Mais tu es pardonné.
bulgarian: I'd forgotten about that! Well, you're forgiven.

english: Oh!
french: Oh !
bulgarian: Oh!

english: Hearing you say that makes me even more grateful that we found each other.
french: T'entendre dire ça me réjouit encore plus que nous nous soyons trouvés.
bulgarian: Hearing you say that makes me even more grateful that we found each other.

english: Oh!
french: Oh !
bulgarian: Oh!

english: Well, that's a weight off my mind anyway.
french: Eh bien, tu m'enlèves un sacré poids.
bulgarian: Well, that's a weight off my mind anyway.

english: Back where it all started...
french: Nous voici revenus là où tout a commencé...
bulgarian: Back where it all started...

english: There's something on your mind?
french: Quelque chose te tracasse ?
bulgarian: There's something on your mind?

english: Well why don't we take a stroll and talk about it?
french: Que dirais-tu d'aller faire un tour pour en discuter ?
bulgarian: Well why don't we take a stroll and talk about it?

english: Ah, [Ari]!
french: Ah, [Ari] !
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]!

english: Magnificent, isn't it? It's very old, certainly older than the town around it. You can find steles like this all over the country, although ours is in particularly good shape.
french: Superbe, n'est-ce pas ? Elle est très ancienne, bien plus encore que la ville elle-même. Il y a des stèles identiques dans tout le pays, mais la nôtre est particulièrement bien conservée.
russian: Грандиозно выглядит, да? Она очень старая — явно старше, чем окружающий город. Подобные стелы можно найти по всей стране, хотя наша особенно хорошо сохранилась.
bulgarian: Magnificent, isn't it? It's very old, certainly older than the town around it. You can find steles like this all over the country, although ours is in particularly good shape.

english: Stele?
french: Une stèle ?
russian: Стелы?
bulgarian: Stele?

english: Do you think it marks where treasure is buried?
french: Elle indique l'endroit où un trésor est enterré ?
russian: Думаешь, там отмечено, где зарыты сокровища?
bulgarian: Do you think it marks where treasure is buried?

english: A hidden compartment?! Don't tell me-
french: Un compartiment caché ?! Mais alors...?
russian: Тайный отсек?! Только не говорите...
bulgarian: A hidden compartment?! Don't tell me-

english: Incredible, they're a perfect match for the ones on the stele! The $Dragonsworn Greaves$! Here this whole time!
french: Incroyable, elles sont identiques à celles représentées sur la stèle ! Ce sont les jambières du paladin du dragon ! Elles ont toujours été là !
russian: Невероятно, они точь-в-точь такие, как изображено на стеле! Поножи драконоверного! Всё это время они были здесь!
bulgarian: Incredible, they're a perfect match for the ones on the stele! The $Dragonsworn Greaves$! Here this whole time!

english: And look inside the hidden compartment, there's more writing!
french: Et regarde, il y a autre chose de gravé à l'intérieur du compartiment !
russian: И загляни внутрь этого тайного отсека, там тоже что-то написано!
bulgarian: And look inside the hidden compartment, there's more writing!

english: This will take time to translate... Can you hand me the greaves, [Ari]?
french: Il va me falloir du temps pour traduire tout cela... Tu veux bien me passer les jambières, [Ari] ?
russian: На перевод потребуется время... Передай мне поножи, пожалуйста, [Ari].
bulgarian: This will take time to translate... Can you hand me the greaves, [Ari]?

english: Thank you. Now to get these to the Museum!
french: Merci. Apportons-les au musée !
russian: Спасибо. Пойду отнесу их в музей!
bulgarian: Thank you. Now to get these to the Museum!

english: An ancient monument. They were put up for all sorts of reasons. Memorials, to mark boundaries, or to commemorate great events.
french: Un monument très ancien. On en érigeait pour diverses raisons. En l'honneur d'une personne, pour marquer une frontière ou encore pour célébrer des événements marquants.
russian: Древний монумент. Их возводили по самым разным причинам. Как памятники, как пограничные камни или как напоминания о важных событиях.
bulgarian: An ancient monument. They were put up for all sorts of reasons. Memorials, to mark boundaries, or to commemorate great events.

english: Wouldn't that be nice! However, people who hide treasure usually don't mark it so obviously.
french: Ce serait fantastique ! Malheureusement, ceux qui cachent des trésors n'indiquent généralement pas l'emplacement aussi clairement.
russian: Было бы здорово! Однако когда люди прячут сокровища, они обычно не так явно обозначают место.
bulgarian: Wouldn't that be nice! However, people who hide treasure usually don't mark it so obviously.

english: Our stele depicts a legendary set of armor, worn by someone called the $Dragonsworn$. It's quite unique!
french: Notre stèle montre une armure légendaire portée par celui qu'on appelait autrefois le paladin du dragon. Elle est unique en son genre !
russian: На нашей стеле изображён древний комплект доспехов, который носил некий драконоверный. Она весьма уникальна!
bulgarian: Our stele depicts a legendary set of armor, worn by someone called the $Dragonsworn$. It's quite unique!

english: Supposedly the $Dragonsworn$ was a nearly mythical being who aided the dragons in the ancient days of the world. Could you imagine!
french: L'on raconte que c'était un être au statut presque mythique qui serait venu en aide aux dragons à l'aube du monde. Tu imagines, un peu ?
russian: Вероятно, драконоверный был полумифическим существом, помогавшим драконам в глубокой древности. Представляешь?
bulgarian: Supposedly the $Dragonsworn$ was a nearly mythical being who aided the dragons in the ancient days of the world. Could you imagine!

english: Y-you don't say!
french: C-C'est incroyable !
russian: Н-не может быть!
bulgarian: Y-you don't say!

english: Haha, d-do you think they're still around?
french: Ha ha, et t-tu crois qu'il est encore dans les parages ?
russian: Ха-ха, т-ты думаешь, он ещё существует?
bulgarian: Haha, d-do you think they're still around?

english: Of course, legends do tend to be full of, well, legendary figures. The truth of the matter has been lost.
french: Évidemment, les légendes sont remplies de personnages... légendaires. La vérité sur son compte appartient désormais au passé.
russian: Разумеется, в легендах обычно множество, собственно, легендарных персонажей. Фактические данные давно утрачены.
bulgarian: Of course, legends do tend to be full of, well, legendary figures. The truth of the matter has been lost.

english: Very funny! I'd settle just for finding their armor!
french: Très drôle ! Je crois que je vais me contenter de trouver son armure !
russian: Очень смешно! Меня устроит хотя бы найти его доспех!
bulgarian: Very funny! I'd settle just for finding their armor!

english: Although the armor and the details around the $Dragonsworn$ have been lost to us, thanks to this stele, we do have some clues. Come here!
french: Même si nous savons peu de choses du paladin du dragon et de son équipement, cette stèle nous fournit heureusement quelques pistes. Viens voir !
russian: Хотя доспехи и сведения о драконоверных для нас утрачены, благодаря этой стеле у нас есть некоторые зацепки. Подойди сюда!
bulgarian: Although the armor and the details around the $Dragonsworn$ have been lost to us, thanks to this stele, we do have some clues. Come here!

english: If you place your hands along the surface of the stele, you should still be able to feel raised lettering that's undetectable at first glance.
french: Parcours la surface de la stèle avec tes doigts. Tu vas sentir des lettres gravées indétectables au premier coup d'œil.
russian: Если положишь руки на поверхность стелы, то сможешь нащупать выступающую гравировку, незаметную с первого взгляда.
bulgarian: If you place your hands along the surface of the stele, you should still be able to feel raised lettering that's undetectable at first glance.

english: [Ari], welcome! Come on, it's this way.
french: Bienvenue, [Ari] ! Viens, par ici.
russian: [Ari], добро пожаловать! Проходи вот сюда.
bulgarian: [Ari], welcome! Come on, it's this way.

english: I'll let you know as soon as I'm done translating the new text. Could you imagine if it led us to another piece of the armor?

russian: Как только я переведу этот новый текст, я сразу тебе расскажу. Представляешь, вдруг он приведёт нас к ещё одной детали доспехов?
bulgarian: I'll let you know as soon as I'm done translating the new text. Could you imagine if it led us to another piece of the armor?
