russian: А... п-прости.
bulgarian: Ah... s-sorry.

english: Alright, now keep holding it steady, just like that.
french: Voilà, ne relâche pas, reste comme ça.
russian: Отлично, продолжай держать крепко, вот так.
bulgarian: Alright, now keep holding it steady, just like that.

english: Oh my gosh! Is it done?
french: Ça alors ! Vous avez terminé ?
russian: О боже! Он готов?
bulgarian: Oh my gosh! Is it done?

english: Yes!
french: Oui !
russian: Да!
bulgarian: Yes!

english: Whoa...
french: Waouh...
russian: Ого...
bulgarian: Whoa...

english: I'll get this bundled up and have a courier take it to my mother as fast as they can ride.
french: Je vais le faire emballer et envoyer un messager l'apporter à ma mère sans attendre.
russian: Сейчас запакую его и попрошу посыльного взять самую скорую лошадь и мчать к матери.
bulgarian: I'll get this bundled up and have a courier take it to my mother as fast as they can ride.

english: [Ari], March, thank you. You two have done something incredible.
french: [Ari], March, merci infiniment. Vous avez réalisé un véritable exploit.
russian: [Ari], Март, спасибо. Вы вдвоём сделали нечто невероятное.
bulgarian: [Ari], March, thank you. You two have done something incredible.

english: I could have handled it myself any other day, you know.
french: Tu sais, j'aurais pu m'en charger tout seul, si j'avais eu assez de temps.
russian: Вообще-то, я бы и сам мог справиться.
bulgarian: I could have handled it myself any other day, you know.

english: But at least we got it done.
french: Enfin, l'important c'est qu'il soit terminé.
russian: Но хорошо, что мы его сделали.
bulgarian: But at least we got it done.

english: Don't make me regret calling you over...
french: Ne me fais pas regretter d'avoir fait appel à toi...
russian: Не заставляй меня жалеть, что позвал тебя...
bulgarian: Don't make me regret calling you over...

english: We make a pretty good team, huh?
french: On forme une bonne équipe, hein ?
russian: У нас хорошая команда, да?
bulgarian: We make a pretty good team, huh?

english: Do you two still need help with the other orders?
french: Vous avez toujours besoin d'aide pour les commandes, tous les deux ?
russian: Вам ещё нужна помощь с другими заказами?
bulgarian: Do you two still need help with the other orders?

english: You just happened to be in the right place at the right time.
french: Tu étais au bon endroit au bon moment, c'est tout.
russian: Тебе просто повезло быть в нужное время в нужном месте.
bulgarian: You just happened to be in the right place at the right time.

english: Actually about that...
french: À ce propos...
russian: Кстати, насчёт заказов...
bulgarian: Actually about that...

english: Adeline arranged for extensions on everyone's orders. We have the time to handle them now!
french: Adeline s'est arrangée pour nous donner plus de temps pour les commandes des uns et des autres. On va s'en sortir, maintenant !
russian: Аделина договорилась со всеми о продлении сроков. Теперь у нас есть время со всем справиться!
bulgarian: Adeline arranged for extensions on everyone's orders. We have the time to handle them now!

english: She's like... way good at organizing stuff.
french: Elle est vraiment douée pour... l'organisation des choses.
russian: Она вообще... даже слишком хорошая в организации.
bulgarian: She's like... way good at organizing stuff.

english: Sounds like we've got it from here.
french: Apparemment, on devrait pouvoir se débrouiller.
russian: Кажется, дальше мы сами справимся.
bulgarian: Sounds like we've got it from here.

english: Thanks for your help, [Ari]!
french: Merci pour ton aide, [Ari] !
russian: Спасибо за помощь, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thanks for your help, [Ari]!

english: Y-yeah.
french: Ou-Ouais.
russian: Д-да.
bulgarian: Y-yeah.

english: Y-yeah.
french: Ou-Oui.
russian: Д-да.
bulgarian: Y-yeah.

english: You're the raddest, [Ari]! Now let's see what we can do about this pile of orders!
french: Tu assures, [Ari] ! Alors, voyons tout ce qu'on a dans ce carnet de commandes !
russian: Ты круче всех, [Ari]! Так, давайте посмотрим, что делать с этой грудой заказов.
bulgarian: You're the raddest, [Ari]! Now let's see what we can do about this pile of orders!

english: Oh hi everyone!
french: Oh, bonjour tout le monde !
russian: Ой, привет, ребята!
bulgarian: Oh hi everyone!

english: [Ari], I'm glad you're here too!
french: [Ari], ravie de te voir aussi ici !
russian: [Ari], рада, что ты тоже тут!
bulgarian: [Ari], I'm glad you're here too!

english: I don't think we can squeeze anything else into our schedule.
french: Je crois qu'on ne pourra rien accepter de plus, notre carnet de commandes est plein.
russian: Не уверен, что у нас в графике ещё на что-то есть место.
bulgarian: I don't think we can squeeze anything else into our schedule.

english: Well done.
french: Beau travail.
russian: Отличная работа.
bulgarian: Well done.

english: Adeline was over the moon at how the shield turned out, I'm sure Linnet feels the same.
french: Adeline était ravie de ce bouclier et je suis sûre qu'il en est allé de même pour Linnet.
russian: Аделина наглядеться не может на этот щит, и, я уверена, Линнет тоже.
bulgarian: Adeline was over the moon at how the shield turned out, I'm sure Linnet feels the same.

english: Might want to order something you don't need to eat with a fork today.
french: Si tu veux commander à manger aujourd'hui, mieux vaut éviter tout ce qui nécessite une fourchette.
russian: Возможно, сегодня лучше заказать что-нибудь, что можно есть без вилки.
bulgarian: Might want to order something you don't need to eat with a fork today.

english: Seems my cutlery order at the blacksmith is a bit delayed.
french: Apparemment, les couverts que j'ai commandés à la forge arriveront avec un peu de retard.
russian: Вижу, мой заказ столовых приборов из кузницы задерживается.
bulgarian: Seems my cutlery order at the blacksmith is a bit delayed.

english: Though I thought he'd be happier about the whole thing, you know?
french: Mais je pensais qu'il serait plus heureux que ça, tu vois ?
russian: Хотя, знаешь, я думал, он больше обрадуется этому делу.
bulgarian: Though I thought he'd be happier about the whole thing, you know?

english: He always talks about wanting to make his mark as a blacksmith with bigger projects like this.
french: Il parle toujours de se faire connaître en tant que forgeron grâce à ce genre de gros projets.
russian: Он часто говорит, что хочет оставить свой след как кузнец в больших проектах вроде этого.
bulgarian: He always talks about wanting to make his mark as a blacksmith with bigger projects like this.

english: M-maybe he's just not used to sharing credit?
french: I-Il aurait peut-être préféré que tout le mérite lui revienne ?
russian: М-может, он просто не привык делить с кем-то славу?
bulgarian: M-maybe he's just not used to sharing credit?

english: I've been telling everyone about that rad shield you and March made!
french: J'ai parlé à tout le monde de ce magnifique bouclier que vous avez fabriqué, March et toi !
russian: Я всем рассказал, какой крутой щит вы с Мартом сделали!
bulgarian: I've been telling everyone about that rad shield you and March made!

english: More importantly, look at you! Just think about your work being shown off in the Capital!
french: Mais parlons plutôt de toi ! Ton travail va être présenté à la capitale, tu imagines ?
russian: Но главное, ты молодец! Только представь: твою работу будут выставлять в столице!
bulgarian: More importantly, look at you! Just think about your work being shown off in the Capital!

english: Adeline came by and let me know some of my blacksmithing orders would be delayed. I told her no problem.
french: Adeline est passée me dire que certaines de mes commandes à la forge seraient en retard. Je lui ai dit qu'il n'y avait aucun problème.
russian: Аделина недавно зашла сказать, что мои заказы в кузнице задерживаются. Я сказал: «Без проблем».
bulgarian: Adeline came by and let me know some of my blacksmithing orders would be delayed. I told her no problem.

english: Everything okay?
french: Tout se passe bien ?
bulgarian: Everything okay?

english: You want to go somewhere to talk? Sure, I have time.
french: Tu veux me parler de quelque chose ? Aucun problème, j'ai le temps.
bulgarian: You want to go somewhere to talk? Sure, I have time.

english: Why don't we go up to the $Summit$?
french: Ça te dirait d'aller au $sommet$ ?
bulgarian: Why don't we go up to the $Summit$?

english: Oh, [Ari]! Hey.
french: Oh, [Ari] ! Salut !
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]! Hey.

english: Maybe we should make an effort to hike up to the Summit more often.
french: On devrait grimper plus souvent jusqu'au sommet.
bulgarian: Maybe we should make an effort to hike up to the Summit more often.

english: The way your eyes light up when you smile. The way your cheeks flush near the heat of the forge...
french: La façon dont ton regard s'illumine quand tu ris... Tes joues qui rosissent quand tu approches de la forge...
bulgarian: The way your eyes light up when you smile. The way your cheeks flush near the heat of the forge...

english: Your unwavering persistence in the face of, er... stubbornness.
french: Ta détermination sans faille et ta persévérance quand tu te retrouves face à des gens... butés et récalcitrants.
bulgarian: Your unwavering persistence in the face of, er... stubbornness.

english: Yeah, I get that.
french: Oui, je comprends.
bulgarian: Yeah, I get that.

english: But you know, I... I always noticed certain things about you. Even if I didn't care to mention them at the time.
french: Mais tu sais, je... j'ai toujours remarqué certaines choses chez toi. Même si je ne préférais pas t'en parler, à ce moment-là.
bulgarian: But you know, I... I always noticed certain things about you. Even if I didn't care to mention them at the time.

english: The way your eyes light up when you smile. The way your cheeks flush near the heat of the forge...
french: La façon dont ton regard s'illumine quand tu ris... Tes joues qui rosissent quand tu approches de la forge...
bulgarian: The way your eyes light up when you smile. The way your cheeks flush near the heat of the forge...

english: Your unwavering persistence in the face of, er... stubbornness.
french: Ta détermination sans faille et ta persévérance quand tu te retrouves face à des gens... butés et récalcitrants.
bulgarian: Your unwavering persistence in the face of, er... stubbornness.

english: I don't know what compelled you to give me a second chance back then-
french: Je ne sais pas ce qui t'a poussé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> à me donner une deuxième chance, à l'époque...
bulgarian: I don't know what compelled you to give me a second chance back then-

english: Or a third, or a fourth...
french: Voire une troisième ou une quatrième...
bulgarian: Or a third, or a fourth...

english: But [Ari]...
french: Mais [Ari]...
bulgarian: But [Ari]...

english: I'm so glad that you did.
french: Je suis très content que tu l'aies fait.
bulgarian: I'm so glad that you did.

english: Looking out over the town with you, everything seems more...
french: Quand j'observe la ville d'ici avec toi, j'ai l'impression que tout est plus...
bulgarian: Looking out over the town with you, everything seems more...

english: My heart was closed off, when you first arrived.
french: Mon cœur était fermé quand tu es arrivé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they>.
bulgarian: My heart was closed off, when you first arrived.

english: It had been, for a long time already.
french: Et c'était le cas depuis déjà longtemps.
bulgarian: It had been, for a long time already.

english: I didn't like the thought of anything, anyone breaking through.
french: Je n'aimais pas l'idée que quelque chose l'atteigne. Je trouvais ça... menaçant.
bulgarian: I didn't like the thought of anything, anyone breaking through.

english: But you just kept chipping away. With each hello, with each smile.
french: Mais tu as fait tomber mes défenses petit à petit. À chaque bonjour, à chaque sourire.
bulgarian: But you just kept chipping away. With each hello, with each smile.

english: Until before I knew it... You'd changed me.
french: Jusqu'à ce que, sans même m'en rendre compte, tu aies réussi à me faire changer.
bulgarian: Until before I knew it... You'd changed me.

english: You changed me, too. I gained a new kind of strength...
french: J'ai aussi changé grâce à toi. J'ai découvert une nouvelle force en moi.
bulgarian: You changed me, too. I gained a new kind of strength...

english: Forged by the fire in my heart...
french: Comme du métal, tu as fondu dans les flammes de mon cœur...
bulgarian: Forged by the fire in my heart...

english: Really, [Ari]?
french: Vraiment, [Ari] ?
bulgarian: Really, [Ari]?

english: [Ari]! Haha... yeah, honestly. That is what it feels like.
french: [Ari] ! Ha ha... Oui, c'est vrai. C'est l'impression que ça donne.
bulgarian: [Ari]! Haha... yeah, honestly. That is what it feels like.

english: I hope that means you can forgive me for being such a jerk back then.
french: J'espère que ça veut dire que tu peux me pardonner d'avoir été aussi exécrable, à l'époque.
bulgarian: I hope that means you can forgive me for being such a jerk back then.

english: I was cold. I know that. And yet-
french: J'étais distant. Je le sais. Mais...
bulgarian: I was cold. I know that. And yet-

english: I sometimes wonder if that's just the kind of person I am.
french: Parfois je me demande si c'est tout simplement ma personnalité.
bulgarian: I sometimes wonder if that's just the kind of person I am.

english: Well, more beautiful than before.
french: Que tout est plus beau.
bulgarian: Well, more beautiful than before.

english: It's still not easy for me to open up, you know.
french: Ça n'est toujours pas facile pour moi de m'ouvrir aux autres, tu sais.
bulgarian: It's still not easy for me to open up, you know.

english: There are times I have to fight myself, to keep myself from pushing you away.
french: Parfois, je dois me faire violence pour ne pas te repousser.
bulgarian: There are times I have to fight myself, to keep myself from pushing you away.

english: Not because I don't want you-
french: Pas parce que je ne veux pas de toi...
bulgarian: Not because I don't want you-

english: But because of how intensely I DO want you.
french: Mais justement parce que j'en ai très envie.
bulgarian: But because of how intensely I DO want you.

english: I want you here by my side, always. I want to see your smile...
french: Je veux que tu sois là, à mes côtés, pour toujours. Je veux te voir sourire...
bulgarian: I want you here by my side, always. I want to see your smile...

english: And I want to protect you from anything that might threaten to make it disappear.
french: Et je veux te protéger de tout ce qui pourrait me faire changer d'avis.
bulgarian: And I want to protect you from anything that might threaten to make it disappear.

english: I've been thinking about that a lot lately, [Ari]. And there's something important I want to talk to you about.
french: J'ai beaucoup réfléchi ces temps-ci, [Ari]. Je tiens à te parler d'une chose importante.
bulgarian: I've been thinking about that a lot lately, [Ari]. And there's something important I want to talk to you about.

english: I've been thinking about that a lot lately, [Ari].
french: J'ai beaucoup réfléchi ces temps-ci, [Ari].
bulgarian: I've been thinking about that a lot lately, [Ari].

english: But first, there's something I want to give you. Something I put my heart into forging for you.
french: Mais d'abord, j'ai quelque chose à te donner. J'ai mis tout mon cœur à le forger pour toi.
bulgarian: But first, there's something I want to give you. Something I put my heart into forging for you.

english: That's why I crafted the $Mistrian Shield$ for you.
french: Je t'ai fait ce $bouclier mistrien$.
bulgarian: That's why I crafted the $Mistrian Shield$ for you.

english: I call it the $Mistrian Shield$.
french: Je l'ai appelé le $bouclier mistrien$.
bulgarian: I call it the $Mistrian Shield$.

english: It represents my promise...
french: Il représente une promesse que je te fais...
bulgarian: It represents my promise...

english: It's my promise to you. To protect you, and your happiness, no matter what.
french: C'est la promesse que je te fais. De vous protéger, ton bonheur et toi, quoi qu'il puisse arriver.
bulgarian: It's my promise to you. To protect you, and your happiness, no matter what.

english: To protect you, and your happiness, no matter what.
french: De vous protéger, toi et le bonheur qui t'entoure, quoi qu'il puisse arriver.
bulgarian: To protect you, and your happiness, no matter what.

english: Don't get me wrong, I know you've worked hard to restore Mistria. That's not exactly what I'm talking about, though...
french: Ne me fais pas dire ce que je n'ai pas dit. Je sais que tu travailles dur pour redonner sa beauté à Mistria. Mais je ne parle pas de ça...
bulgarian: Don't get me wrong, I know you've worked hard to restore Mistria. That's not exactly what I'm talking about, though...

english: [Ari], I-
french: [Ari], je...
bulgarian: [Ari], I-

english: There's something I want to ask you...
french: Il y a quelque chose que je...
bulgarian: There's something I want to ask you...

english: What am I saying?
french: Qu'est-ce que je raconte ?
bulgarian: What am I saying?

english: You're the one who invited me out here to talk! You should go first.
french: C'est toi qui m'as invité ici pour discuter ! Alors, je t'écoute.
bulgarian: You're the one who invited me out here to talk! You should go first.

english: What was on your mind?
french: Qu'est-ce que tu voulais me dire ?
bulgarian: What was on your mind?

english: No, no... after you, really.
french: Non, non... je t'en prie, vas-y.
bulgarian: No, no... after you, really.

english: Let's talk about it another time...
french: Parlons-en une autre fois...
bulgarian: Let's talk about it another time...

english: You want me to go first? Well-
french: Tu veux que je commence ? Bon...
bulgarian: You want me to go first? Well-

english: [Ari], I wanted to ask you-
french: [Ari], je voulais te demander...
bulgarian: [Ari], I wanted to ask you-

english: To ask if you would-
french: Te demander si...
bulgarian: To ask if you would-

english: I mean, will... will you......?
french: Je veux dire... veux-tu...?
bulgarian: I mean, will... will you......?

english: I love you, March. Of course I'll marry you!
french: Je t'aime, March. Évidemment que je veux t'épouser !
bulgarian: I love you, March. Of course I'll marry you!

english: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.
french: Mais parlons-en plus longuement une autre fois, plutôt.
bulgarian: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.

english: There's just something about you, [Ari].
french: Il y a quelque chose chez toi, [Ari]...
bulgarian: There's just something about you, [Ari].

english: You will?
french: Tu veux bien ?!
bulgarian: You will?

english: You'll marry me?
french: Tu vas m'épouser ?!
bulgarian: You'll marry me?

english: You're serious? You're not just teasing me, right?
french: Sérieusement ? Tu n'es pas en train de te moquer de moi, hein ?
bulgarian: You're serious? You're not just teasing me, right?

english: I love you, [Ari]!
french: Je t'aime, [Ari] !
bulgarian: I love you, [Ari]!

english: I feel like I might be dreaming right now...
french: J'ai l'impression d'être en train de rêver, là tout de suite...
bulgarian: I feel like I might be dreaming right now...

english: I thought so much about how I was going to ask you, the whole time I was working on your $Mistrian Shield$...
french: Pendant que je travaillais à ce $bouclier mistrien$, je n'arrêtais pas de penser à la façon dont j'allais te faire ma demande...
bulgarian: I thought so much about how I was going to ask you, the whole time I was working on your $Mistrian Shield$...

english: And I thought about a hundred different ways you might say "no".
french: Et j'ai imaginé les centaines de façons dont tu allais refuser...
bulgarian: And I thought about a hundred different ways you might say "no".

english: But now it seems ridiculous that I was ever afraid. E-even if it was hard to get the words out.
french: Maintenant, le simple fait d'avoir eu peur me paraît ridicule. M-Même si les mots ont eu du mal à sortir.
bulgarian: But now it seems ridiculous that I was ever afraid. E-even if it was hard to get the words out.

english: I'm going to marry you, [Ari]! You're mine! I'm so happy!
french: Je vais t'épouser, [Ari] ! Tu seras à moi et je serai à toi ! Je suis si heureux !
bulgarian: I'm going to marry you, [Ari]! You're mine! I'm so happy!

english: Are you sure?
french: C'est sûr ?
bulgarian: Are you sure?

english: I don't know what it is, exactly...
french: Je ne sais pas exactement ce que c'est...
bulgarian: I don't know what it is, exactly...

english: Well in that case, just let me know when you want to talk, okay?
french: Dans ce cas, préviens-moi quand tu voudras discuter, d'accord ?
bulgarian: Well in that case, just let me know when you want to talk, okay?

english: Yeah... Maybe that's for the best.
french: Ouais... C'est sûrement mieux comme ça.
bulgarian: Yeah... Maybe that's for the best.

english: I can't seem to get my words out today, anyway.
french: De toute façon, j'ai l'impression que les mots ne sortent pas comme je veux, aujourd'hui.
bulgarian: I can't seem to get my words out today, anyway.

english: Just let me know when you want to talk, okay?
french: Préviens-moi quand tu voudras discuter, d'accord ?
bulgarian: Just let me know when you want to talk, okay?

english: You make me see things differently than I used to. I wouldn't have guessed that was possible, back when we first met.
french: Tu as changé la façon dont je voyais les choses. Je n'aurais pas cru ça possible au début, quand on s'est rencontrés.
bulgarian: You make me see things differently than I used to. I wouldn't have guessed that was possible, back when we first met.

english: Back then, I hoped one day you might one day see me differently, too...
french: À l'époque, j'espérais qu'un jour, tu te ferais une autre idée de moi...
bulgarian: Back then, I hoped one day you might one day see me differently, too...

english: When we first met, I wouldn't have thought it possible either...
french: Quand on s'est connus, je n'aurais pas cru ça possible non plus...
bulgarian: When we first met, I wouldn't have thought it possible either...

english: I uh... I always noticed certain things about you. Even if I didn't care to mention them at the time.
french: Je, euh... J'ai toujours remarqué certaines choses chez toi. Même si je ne préférais pas t'en parler, à ce moment-là.
bulgarian: I uh... I always noticed certain things about you. Even if I didn't care to mention them at the time.

english: Wow, it's so nice up here...
french: Ouah, c'est vraiment génial ici...
bulgarian: Wow, it's so nice up here...

english: I hear you've been making yourself useful around town. Everybody only has good things to say about you.
french: Il paraît que tu donnes des coups de main en ville. Tout le monde ne dit que des choses gentilles sur ton compte.
russian: Я слышал, что ты всем в городе помогаешь. Буквально все хорошо о тебе отзываются.
bulgarian: I hear you've been making yourself useful around town. Everybody only has good things to say about you.

english: It's been lots of fun helping out!
french: J'aime beaucoup apporter mon aide !
russian: Помогать людям весело!
bulgarian: It's been lots of fun helping out!

english: So I guess this is where you apologize for your bad attitude.
french: Donc, c'est là que tu t'excuses de ton comportement à mon égard ?
russian: Я так понимаю, ты так собираешься извиниться за своё отношение?

bulgarian: I wonder if Valen happened to save any seeds?

english: Valen told me all about your adventures finding a Cliffblossom! You're both so brave!
french: Valen m'a raconté toutes vos aventures pour trouver une fleur de roche ! Il vous en a fallu du courage !
russian: Вален мне всё рассказала про ваши приключения с поиском скалоцвета! Какие вы с ней смелые!

english: Those ruins are hiding all sorts of surprises, aren't they?

english: So you and Valen found the Cliffblossom? Incredible work!
french: Alors comme ça, Valen et toi avez trouvé la fleur de roche ? Incroyable !
russian: Значит, вам с Вален удалось найти скалоцвет? Потрясающая работа!
bulgarian: So you and Valen found the Cliffblossom? Incredible work!

english: Eiland and I have already cleaned the site and repaired the damage to the wall. That stonework won't be falling on anyone else!

english: Valen told me about what happened, I'm relieved you're alright, [Ari].
french: Valen m'a raconté ce qui s'est passé, je suis soulagé de savoir que tu vas bien, [Ari].
russian: Вален рассказала мне, что случилось. Я рад, что с тобой всё хорошо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Valen told me about what happened, I'm relieved you're alright, [Ari].

english: Why, with a few more years of training, she might be just as good as Dozy at hunting down rare ingredients!

russian: Быть может, ещё пару годиков тренировок, и она сможет находить редкие ингредиенты не хуже Дрёмы!
bulgarian: Why, with a few more years of training, she might be just as good as Dozy at hunting down rare ingredients!

english: Oh ho ho!
french: Ho ho ho !
russian: О-хо-хо!
bulgarian: Oh ho ho!

english: Please extend my congratulations to you and Valen on finding the last ingredient for her little poultice.
french: Permets-moi de vous féliciter, Valen et toi, pour avoir trouvé le dernier ingrédient qui compose son petit cataplasme.
russian: Вы с Вален можете принять от меня поздравления по поводу финального ингредиента для её пустячного снадобья.

english: Now I just need to figure out why it loses its effectiveness if it's taken outside of Mistria...

russian: Теперь мне предстоит разгадать, почему она теряет свои целебные свойства при вывозе из Мистрии...
bulgarian: Now I just need to figure out why it loses its effectiveness if it's taken outside of Mistria...

english: It's an exciting time!
french: Les recherches continuent !
russian: Вот это интересная задачка!
bulgarian: It's an exciting time!

english: I feel such a sense of relief, now that we have recovered the panacea's recipe.
french: Je me sens tellement soulagée d'avoir pu retrouver la recette de la panacée.
russian: Теперь, когда мы воссоздали рецепт панацеи, я чувствую такое облегчение.
bulgarian: I feel such a sense of relief, now that we have recovered the panacea's recipe.

english: Now I just need to figure out why it loses its effectiveness if it's taken outside of Mistria...
french: Maintenant, je dois comprendre pourquoi elle ne marche plus dès qu'on l'emmène hors de Mistria...
russian: Теперь мне предстоит разгадать, почему она теряет свои целебные свойства при вывозе из Мистрии...

english: I suppose it's another mystery for us to unravel.

russian: Наверное, это ещё одна тайна, которую мы разгадаем вместе.
bulgarian: I suppose it's another mystery for us to unravel.

english: I feel such a sense of relief, now that we have recovered the panacea's recipe.
french: Je me sens tellement soulagée d'avoir pu retrouver la recette de la panacée.
russian: Теперь, когда мы воссоздали рецепт панацеи, я чувствую такое облегчение.
bulgarian: I feel such a sense of relief, now that we have recovered the panacea's recipe.

english: An experiment on the nature of the bacteria in this soil.
french: C'est pour une expérience sur la nature de la bactérie présente dans cette terre.
russian: Для экспериментов над бактериями в почве.

english: Thank you [Ari], it means a lot to me that I can trust you.

russian: Спасибо, [Ari], для меня важно знать, что тебе можно доверять.
bulgarian: Thank you [Ari], it means a lot to me that I can trust you.

russian: Любопытно, не знала, что в этом сонном городке есть скандальные тайны.
bulgarian: Interesting, I didn't think this sleepy little town had any juicy secrets!

english: This is batch three hundred and twelve.
french: C'est le trois cent douzième échantillon.
russian: Это образец 312.
bulgarian: This is batch three hundred and twelve.

russian: Тогда давай я выпью. Ради науки!
bulgarian: Then let me drink it, for science!

russian: Можно, я выпью? Выглядит вкусно...

french: Personne ne s'était jamais porté volontaire à ma place. C'est très généreux de ta part.
russian: У меня никогда не было волонтёров, это благородно с твоей стороны.

russian: Ты думаешь? Я, эм, не заботилась о вкусе и внешнем виде эликсира.

english: Ready!
french: Cul-sec !
russian: Готова!

english: Oh dear.
french: Oh non.
russian: О боже.

english: I-it's not creepy!

russian: О-он не жуткий!
bulgarian: I-it's not creepy!

english: Coming to? How do you feel?

russian: Ты в сознании? Как самочувствие?
bulgarian: Coming to? How do you feel?

english: I saw my life flash before my eyes...
french: J'ai vu ma vie défiler devant mes yeux...
russian: Перед глазами вся жизнь промелькнула...
bulgarian: I saw my life flash before my eyes...

english: I feel great!
french: Je suis au top de ma forme !
russian: Чувствую себя отлично!
bulgarian: I feel great!

english: I'm sorry, [Ari].
french: Je te présente mes excuses, [Ari].
russian: Прости, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'm sorry, [Ari].

french: J'espère bien. J'ai utilisé ce qu'il restait de panacée pour te remettre sur pied après que l'essai a échoué.

english: I've wanted to keep my work secret until I was successful, but with the last of the panacea gone, this has become more urgent...
french: Je tenais à garder mes travaux secrets jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats, mais comme il n'y a plus du tout de panacée, il commence à y avoir urgence...
russian: Я хотела держать работу втайне, пока не добьюсь успеха. Но теперь панацея закончилась и мне надо поторопиться...
bulgarian: I've wanted to keep my work secret until I was successful, but with the last of the panacea gone, this has become more urgent...

english: Can I count on you to help me, [Ari]?
french: Je peux compter sur ton aide, [Ari] ?
russian: Я могу рассчитывать на твою помощь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Can I count on you to help me, [Ari]?

english: Thank you.
french: Merci.
russian: Спасибо.
bulgarian: Thank you.

english: I promise not to risk harming your health again.
french: Je te promets de ne plus jamais te mettre en danger.
russian: Я обещаю больше не подвергать твоё здоровье опасности.

french: Je vais rassembler toutes mes notes pour essayer de comprendre exactement ce qui ne va pas. Je te préviendrai quand je commencerai à préparer le prochain lot.
russian: Я соберу все свои заметки и попробую уточнить, что пошло не так. Я сообщу тебе, когда начну готовить следующий экспериментальный образец.
bulgarian: I'm going to collect all my notes together and try to narrow down what's gone wrong. I'll let you know when it's time to start mixing up the next test batch.

english: Would you like to come down and see my work?

russian: Хочешь спуститься посмотреть на мою работу?
bulgarian: Would you like to come down and see my work?

english: My family have been doctors for generations, this is our laboratory. Over the years, my ancestors made many contributions to the science of medicine.

bulgarian: My family have been doctors for generations, this is our laboratory. Over the years, my ancestors made many contributions to the science of medicine.

english: One of whom invented the panacea I used to instantly cure Hayden's ankle.

russian: Одна из них изобрела панацею, с помощью которой я вылечила ногу Хейдена.
bulgarian: One of whom invented the panacea I used to instantly cure Hayden's ankle.

english: She made a stockpile of it that my family has been using over the years only when there's been a real need for it.

russian: Она оставила запас порошка, который годами используется в моей семье, когда он действительно нужен.
bulgarian: She made a stockpile of it that my family has been using over the years only when there's been a real need for it.

english: I've made it my life's work to recreate the recipe, which has been lost to time. I think I'm getting close...
french: Je consacre ma vie à retrouver cette formule perdue avec le temps. Je crois que je n'en suis plus très loin.
russian: Я считаю делом своей жизни воссоздание её рецепта, который утрачен в веках. Думаю, я уже близка к разгадке...
bulgarian: I've made it my life's work to recreate the recipe, which has been lost to time. I think I'm getting close...

english: I'm telling you this because I think I can trust you with this secret, [Ari]. I can trust you, yes?
french: Je te dis tout ça parce que je pense pouvoir te confier mes secrets, [Ari]. Je peux te faire confiance, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Я тебе это сообщаю, потому что верю, что тебе можно доверить тайну, [Ari]. Можно ведь?

french: Si tu savais tous les secrets que je garde !
russian: Ты не поверишь, каких тайн мне уже нарассказывали!
bulgarian: You wouldn't believe the secrets I'm already keeping!

english: I think two hundred tesserae is fitting for such high quality peat. Thank you again, [Ari].
french: Deux cents tesserae, ça me paraît juste pour de la tourbe de cette qualité. Encore merci, [Ari].
russian: Думаю, двести тессер — достойная цена за такой качественный торф.
bulgarian: I think two hundred tesserae is fitting for such high quality peat. Thank you again, [Ari].

english: What are you going to use it for?
french: Elle va te servir à quoi ?
russian: Как ты собираешься его использовать?
bulgarian: What are you going to use it for?

french: Hé, je peux voir encore une fois ta mystérieuse cave ?
russian: А можно ещё раз взглянуть на твой жуткий подвал?
bulgarian: Hey, can I see your creepy basement again?

french: Oh, c'est pour ma requête ? Merci, viens avec moi, je vais te régler ça.
russian: О, ты по поводу моей просьбы? Спасибо! Пойдём со мной, я тебе заплачу.
bulgarian: Oh, for my request? Thank you! Come with me and I'll get your payment.

english: How could I possibly think of refusing, Doctor Valen?
french: Jamais je n'aurais pu refuser, docteure Valen.
russian: Ну как же я могла отказаться, докторша Вален?

bulgarian: Why Valen, your test subject speaks! Good to know your reckless experiments didn't do any permanent damage.

english: I suppose it is a mark of sincerity that you two would be willing to embarrass yourselves like this...
